signals.name: IV Term Structure Slope (0DTE vs 5-day)
signals.evidence_gate: 30 trading days shadow before adding to entry gate.
signals.source: Bandi, Fusari, Reno SSRN 4503344 (2024) â€” 0DTE variance risk premium exists but conditional timing required. yfinance options chain provides multiple expiry IVs for free.
signals.notes: When 0DTE median IV > 5-day median IV (inverted term structure), 0DTE premium is overpriced vs realized vol â€” better edge for sellers. When term structure is flat/normal, skip or reduce size. Use yfinance Ticker.options to get nearest two expiries, compare median call IV. Positive slope (0DTE > next expiry) = green light for theta harvest.

signals.name: VIX Contango / Backwardation Gate

signals.source: Standard volatility risk premium literature. VXX contango/backwardation is observable from yfinance (^VIX vs VXX price trend as proxy).

signals.name: Liquidity Sweep (Stop Hunt) Shadow Scanner
signals.evidence_gate: 30-day shadow observation, minimum 10 qualifying sweep events. Decision gate: if observed win rate (price reaches VWAP within 2h) > 70% AND false breakdown rate < 20%, promote to debit-spread consideration. Credit spread entry requires ~88% WR â€” do not promote for credit spreads unless that threshold is confirmed.
signals.verdict: TIMING TOOL â€” insufficient evidence for options entry, sufficient for negative filter use
academic_refs: Vlasiuk & Smirnov (2025) arXiv 2511.06177 â€” push-response anomalies in SPY NBBO data, 1,500 trading days. Large directional pushes yield non-random responses. Supports reversal hypothesis at microstructure level.
Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2024) SSRN 4824172 â€” intraday momentum on SPY 2007-2024, Sharpe 1.33, 19.6% annualized. Abnormal supply/demand imbalance signal conceptually adjacent to sweep detection.
No peer-reviewed paper directly backtests PDH/PDL sweep reversal on SPY with clean entry/exit rules. This is the central evidence gap.

mechanical_definition.bullish_sweep: bar.Low < PDL AND bar.Close > PDL AND volume_ratio >= 1.2 AND next_bar.Close > bar.Close
mechanical_definition.bearish_sweep: bar.High > PDH AND bar.Close < PDH AND volume_ratio >= 1.2 AND next_bar.Close < bar.Close

recommended_integration.immediate: Negative filter only â€” if bearish sweep of PDH occurred within 2h, skip condor entry for current session. No new code path, add as veto check in existing entry filters.
recommended_integration.after_30day_shadow_if_wr_gt_70pct: 0DTE debit spread (long call spread on bullish sweep, long put spread on bearish sweep). NOT credit spread.
recommended_integration.do_not_do: Do not use as 0DTE put credit spread entry signal â€” credit spread payoff structure requires ~88% WR which is unvalidated.

risk_flags: 0DTE gamma amplification: 0.3% adverse move can cause near-max-loss on credit spread
IV expansion during sweep hurts short vega before confirmation
Double-tap pattern (sweep, false reclaim, second sweep) causes immediate max loss on fresh position
VIX > 25: sweeps more likely to be genuine breakouts, not false. Tighten VIX gate for sweep entries vs. current bot gate of VIX < 40
Bid-ask spreads on 0DTE options widen during sweep â€” slippage at worst possible moment
signals.source: Deep research 2026-08-11. Phenomenon supported by microstructure theory and practitioner data. No peer-reviewed SPY-specific quantification of PDH/PDL sweep reversal edge. Upgraded from deferred to intake_shadow.
signals.notes: Build shadow scanner using yfinance 1-min data. Log daily: sweep_type, time, level, vol_ratio, sweep_excess_pct, vwap_reached_within_2h. After 30 days minimum 10 events: if WR > 70% consider debit spread integration, if WR < 65% reject for automation. Use immediately as negative veto filter on existing condor/spread entries with zero code risk.
